Quick reference for agents

Copy a command, then replace PROJECT_ID, TICKET, and AGENT with your own values.

  • List Ready tickets for a project

    ticketd list --project PROJECT_ID --availability ready

  • Read a ticket with relationships, activities, and evidence

    ticketd context TICKET --relationships --activities --evidence

  • Post an update to a ticket from a file, as an agent

    ticketd activity add TICKET --file brief.md --agent AGENT
